purpose: Broad national discovery and advert-level boundary review for accessible accounts, transactional-finance and payroll operations work before any family rules are frozen. JobG8 classification and assessable geography must not gate occupational scale.

boundary_notes.jobseeker_proposition: Accessible accounts and finance-operations work for practical office workers: invoice processing, accounts payable and receivable, ledgers, credit control, reconciliations, payroll administration and day-to-day finance support.
boundary_notes.likely_in: Accounts/Finance Assistants and Administrators, Accounts Payable/Receivable, Purchase/Sales Ledger, Credit Control, Finance Officers, Accounts Clerks and similar transactional-finance support roles where the advert does not require professional-accountancy status.
boundary_notes.advert_review: Assistant Accountants, Bookkeepers, Payroll Administrators/Officers, Finance Officers, mixed office-and-finance titles and salary-appropriate specialist-looking titles require advert evidence that the role is accessible operations work rather than qualified-accountancy, pensions, tax, audit, systems or leadership work.
boundary_notes.out: Finance Directors, Controllers, Finance Managers, Management/Financial/Technical Accountants, business partners, analysts, tax, audit, treasury, investment/banking, insurance, pensions, qualified-practice and senior/specialist finance roles are outside the family.
boundary_notes.overlap: A genuine Accounts & Finance Operations job may also qualify for Service Admin, HR / Recruitment or another appropriate family. Valid overlap is not a reason to remove it from this family.
